• Any class, any stronghold. The class sets your powers and your followers, not the building. Each entry suggests the stronghold that suits it best.
  • Demesne effects: the land around your stronghold changes to suit you. The GM picks one or more of the listed effects. They are always on.
  • Stronghold actions:
    • While you are in your stronghold or its home hex, you may take one stronghold action at the start of a round, before anyone acts.
    • Each one can be used once per day.
    • Its DC is your Class Save DC, or your Spell Save DC if the action is a spell.
  • Feature improvement:
    • Each class improves its signature feature.
    • Unless the entry says otherwise, you can use the improvement a number of times equal to your stronghold level, and they come back on an Extended Rest.
    • A multiclass character picks one class to improve and can change it on an Extended Rest.
  • Followers:
    • Roll d100 on your class table when the stronghold is finished, at each upgrade, and each time you gain a Level while you hold it.
    • Retainers arrive at the Level shown, but always at least one Level below you. Their cards are in the Retainer Roster at the end of this chapter.
    • Units are described in Warfare. Each has a Size die, shown in brackets.
    • Artisans and ambassadors are in Chapter 2.
    • Special ally means a roll on the Special Allies table, by your Outlook.

• Your Seat: a stronghold you hold at 20th level is your Seat, as the Handbook's Renown describes.
  • Both benefits: your class's Seat benefit from the Handbook adds to everything your stronghold gives you here.
  • Followers: the followers the Handbook says your Seat draws each season are rolled on your class's follower table below, unless the Handbook names them, as the Knight's does.

Suggested stronghold: keep.

Demesne effects

  • The wind never spoils a shot. Ranged attacks by you and your allies ignore wind and weather.
  • Archers who train here for a season count as one experience step better (Warfare).
  • Game is plentiful, and fletching never runs short. Your Arrow Repertoire costs nothing to stock here.

Stronghold actions

  • Arrow Storm: each enemy within 120ft that you can see makes a Reflex save or takes 4d8 piercing, half on a success.
  • Pinning Volley: each enemy within 60ft makes a Reflex save or can't move until the end of its next turn.
  • Eagle Eye: until the end of the round, ranged attacks by you and your allies ignore cover and have Advantage.

Feature improvement: Hail Unending. Use Hail of Arrows a second time in the same encounter.

  • You sense any construct that enters the demesne.

  • Overcharge: your Kit's next use this round costs no Ingenuity Points and has its greatest effect.
  • Lockdown: every door, gate and portcullis you choose slams shut and locks. Each enemy within 60ft makes a Reflex save or is Restrained by nets until it escapes (Hard Strength check, its action).

Feature improvement: Spare Parts. Regain Ingenuity Points equal to your stronghold level, on your turn, as no action.
